name: booklore-react
description: BookLore UI ported to React, backed by a Cloudflare Worker API with R2 object storage

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/worker
